hero.name: Marcin Szczęsny
bio: I take AI from the first client conversation to a system running in production. At Crait I own delivery, operations and the way our team of 15 works. As Tech Lead I run architecture and code review for our product, Career Guide.

I designed the entire system the Crait team uses to manage its work, with people and AI agents working side by side. I keep testing new models and tools, and whatever proves itself goes into our daily work.
Before that I spent many years working with business clients, so I start with the problem, not the technology.

items.name: RagAIn
items.subtitle: Voice-first client records
items.problem: Agreements made during sales visits are easily scattered across notes. Before the next conversation, the salesperson needs to reconstruct the client’s history.
items.approach: A voice note becomes a transcript and proposed record updates. The model returns schema-validated data for the user to approve before saving. An agreement history and hybrid search support client briefings.
items.technology: React, Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI, Supabase / PostgreSQL (pgvector), embeddings, hybrid search.

items.name: Sygnoza
items.subtitle: Procurement opportunity radar
items.problem: Procurement notices are spread across the BZP public-procurement bulletin and individual institution websites. Salespeople need to identify relevant opportunities by region and product range.
items.approach: Imports notices and scans selected sites, removes duplicates and filters by region and supply type. Opportunity cards summarise requirements and link back to source documents.
items.technology: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL / SQLite, BeautifulSoup, PDF and spreadsheet extraction, Docker.

items.name: Neuralogistics
items.subtitle: Route and load planning
items.problem: Delivery planning must account for orders, available vehicles, the road network and transport costs.
items.approach: Combines order and fleet management with delivery allocation and route optimisation. Vehicle-routing algorithms and clustering work alongside OSRM road-network routing.
items.technology: React, TypeScript, Node.js / Express, PostgreSQL / PostGIS, Redis, OSRM, Docker.

items.name: TC421
items.subtitle: Local lighting control
items.problem: LED-controller schedules should be editable from a phone, with a practical way to save and restore configurations.
items.approach: An Android app and desktop interface for scenes and schedules. Communication with the controller uses local UDP; configurations can be saved, imported and exported.
items.technology: Kotlin / Android WebView, JavaScript, UDP, Python.

items.name: Oferta
items.subtitle: Sales quotes and promotional materials
items.problem: Price lists, customer discounts, quotes and sales leaflets need consistent data as products and prices change.
items.approach: Price-list imports, customer-specific pricing, PDF / Excel exports and print-ready leaflets. Approved campaigns retain a snapshot of their data, so later price-list updates do not alter their content.
items.technology: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Drizzle, Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2; Python, Jinja2, WeasyPrint, Docker.
